paper_title: Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for   Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation
caption: Results of different logical synthesis modules on BIRD-dev.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two Text-to-SQL systems—NatSQL (light blue) and TA-SQL (dark blue)—across three difficulty levels (Simple, Moderate, Challenging) and an overall Total, as evaluated on the BIRD-dev dataset. The vertical y-axis represents “Execution Accuracy” on a linear scale from 20 to 60, with major tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal x-axis categorizes the results into four groups: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. For each category, two adjacent bars show the performance of NatSQL and TA-SQL respectively. In the Simple category, NatSQL achieves 60.21% and TA-SQL 63.14%; in Moderate, NatSQL scores 39.64% versus TA-SQL’s 48.60%; in Challenging, NatSQL scores 32.32% and TA-SQL 36.11%; and for the Total, NatSQL reaches 51.35% while TA-SQL attains 56.19%. Across all categories, TA-SQL consistently outperforms NatSQL, with the largest absolute gap observed in the Moderate category (8.96 percentage points). The bars are grouped by category and sorted left to right in the order Simple → Moderate → Challenging → Total, with exact accuracy values labeled atop each bar. No bars are shaded, outlined, or annotated beyond their value labels, and the legend at the top distinguishes the two systems by color.
